posts.title: How to Cut No-Shows by 75%: The AcceptPulse Approach
posts.excerpt: Pre-shift confirmation isn't just an app feature — it's a mindset shift that transforms how your workforce shows up, literally.
posts.content:
The Problem

No-shows cost UK businesses an estimated £1.2 billion annually. In temporary staffing, the problem is even more acute — with some agencies reporting no-show rates of 30% or higher.

Our Solution: AcceptPulse

AcceptPulse is our pre-shift confirmation system that has reduced no-shows by 75% across our client base. Here's how it works...
posts.author: James Whitfield

posts.title: Why 98% Fill Rates Are Possible — And What's Stopping You
posts.excerpt: Most agencies promise fill rates. Very few deliver on them consistently. We break down exactly what the 2% gap costs you.
posts.content:
The Industry Average

The average fill rate across the UK temporary staffing sector is just 82%. That means for every 100 shifts requested, 18 go unfilled.
posts.author: Tom Haley
